consumed.text: Hot dam Junior Caminero is on the block. Babe Ruthless is indeed ruthless with shopping his players.

Sources tell me Paul Skenes is done playing for Ep-Skenes Files. His poor management decisions and lack of forward progress has Skenes' team asking for a trade. He is ready to be moved at a moment's notice.
Babe ruthless is quite ruthless with his team. Seems he is not content being middle of the pack and looking for a shake up. Even Ben Rice is on the early chopping block.
E. De La Cruz, is Cruzing to another team! Or it may seem so with how Professor Mcgonigle is shopping him currently.
